summary_en: Tender offer period extended from 2026-07-14 to 2026-07-29 (52 business days total). Tender price ¥1,580/share unchanged. Minimum shares to acquire 19,226,700. Target KAGA Electronics (8154) pursuing complete subsidiary acquisition of Shinko Shoji (8141). Board of target recommends participation; shareholders decide.
title_en: Notice of Extension of Tender Offer Period for Ordinary Shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 8141)
translation_en_brief: KAGA Electronics Co., Ltd. (ticker 8154), the offeror, has extended the tender offer period for ordinary shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (ticker 8141, TSE Prime) from 2026-07-14 to 2026-07-29, expanding the total offer window from 42 to 52 business days. The tender price remains ¥1,580 per share. The minimum share acquisition target is 19,226,700 shares (no upper limit disclosed). The stated purpose is complete subsidiary acquisition (完全子会社化). The board of Shinko Shoji supports the tender but defers the decision to participate to individual shareholders. The extension was decided to provide shareholders with additional time to assess the offer, reflecting cumulative subscription patterns and forward-looking demand. The offeror confirmed that no price adjustment is planned at this time, maintaining that ¥1,580 adequately reflects Shinko Shoji's value and represents the shareholders' best interest.
